notes.title: Now Free to Play on Steam - Hide and Shriek
notes.notes:
Hide and Shriek is Now Free to Play on Steam!

Scare or be scared in this fun Halloween multiplayer game full of hijinks and mischief! Set traps, cast spells, and scare the living hell out of your opponent to win!

notes.title: How to get your Hide and Shriek bonus items!
notes.notes:
If you have purchased Hide and Shriek and want your bonus items in The Secret World, please refer to this handy guide below:
 [list][*]Open your Steam Library and locate the Hide and Shriek page[*]Click "CD Key" under the "LINKS" section from the right side of your Hide and Shriek library page[/list]

 [img]http://l3cdn.funcom.com/tsw/artworks/hns_steam.png[/img]

 [list][*]Copy the Product Code associated with 'Hide and Shriek'[/list]

[img]http://l3cdn.funcom.com/tsw/artworks/hns_steam_2.png[/img]

 [list][*]Go to [url=https://register.thesecretworld.com/account]https://register.thesecretworld.com/account[/url][*]Log in with your The Secret World account information[*]Enter the 'Hide and Shriek" key in the Key Registration box on the top-left of the screen[/list]


[img]http://l3cdn.funcom.com/tsw/artworks/hns_steam_3.png[/img]
[list][*]Click Register to claim your rewards![/list]

notes.title: Patch v.1.053 Update Notes
notes.notes:
[h1]A new version has been released![/h1]

Please update your game to make sure you're on the latest version!

Changelog:
[list]
[*]Added the leaderboard!  You can now compare your best score with your Steam friends!
[*]Unlocked the Rider Mask. Now available to all players! (Reward for an event in [b][url=http://store.steampowered.com/app/215280/]The Secret World[/url][/b] MMO)
[*]Corrected an issue that caused opened doors to not allow players to walk through them.
[*]Fixed an error where traps could trigger on the wrong player.
[*]The "Bookworm" achievement should now always unlock the '[b]Slash[/b]' zombie head.[/list]

notes.title: Patch v.1.052 Update Notes
notes.notes:
[h1]A new version has been released![/h1]

Hide and Shriek has been updated!  Please be sure to patch your game to the latest version.  

Changes:
[list]
[*]Corrected an error that caused some players to not receive customizations when leveling up.  If this happened to you the first time you earn Experience, you will be fixed!
[*]Fixed an issue that caused audio to not play at all, or play to the wrong device.
[*]'[b]It Follows[/b]' will no longer despawn if you shriek and miss your opponent.
[*]Reduced the volume of splash screen cinematics.[/list]

notes.title: Patch v.1.051 Update Notes
notes.notes:
[h1]Patch 1.051 is now live![/h1]

Please make sure you update your client so you get the latest fixes!

[list]
[*]Reduced '[b]Scry[/b]' duration to 15 seconds (from 30 seconds)
[*]Reduced '[b]It Follows[/b]' duration to 20 seconds (from 30 seconds)
[*]Adjusted default quality settings to increase performance on lower end machines
[*]Various localization fixes
[*]Credits will now stop playing when a match starts
[*]Fixed a rare bug which could cause you to hold 2 orbs at once
[/list]

There is an issue with private matches that allow players from 2 different versions to still play each other.  If you notice anything above not working it is probably due to your friend having the wrong install.  Tell them to update!

notes.title: Funcom Show Off First-Person Spooker Hide And Shriek
notes.notes: The Secret World developers Funcom will launch their latest small spin-off game on October 25th, they announced today. Hide and Shriek [official site] is a 1v1 scare ’em up with two teens from Little Springs High and Innsmouth Academy turning themselves invisible to sneak into school and spook each other on Hallowe’en, as you do. They have to watch for tell-tale signs that the other’s about – moving objects, and such – then give ’em a dang good jumpscaring. Kids these days. … [visit site to read more]

notes.title: Funcom s Hide And Shriek Is A 1v1 Jumpscare Em Up
notes.notes:
The Secret World developers Funcom have announced a new spin-off from their supernatural MMORPG, a 1v1 competitive jumpscare ’em up named Hide and Shriek [official site]. It sees two teens sneaking around school on Halloween, trying to find the other one and give them a dang good jumpscaring. Oh, and they’re both invisible. The Innsmouth Academy does have some odd traditions, and we’ll all get to join in this Halloween when the game arrives.

… [visit site to read more]
